descriptionChirho: Qal: to carry, bear, or sustain a load or burden, whether physical (Gen 49:15, Isa 46:4,7) or figurative of bearing sorrows, iniquities, and punishments (Isa 53:4,11, Lam 5:7).
Pual (passive): to be laden or loaded with goods or cargo; of cattle or beasts weighed down with burdens (Psa 144:14).
Hitpael (reflexive): to drag or carry oneself along with difficulty; used of the grasshopper in the allegory of old age (Eccl 12:5).
